one_line: Nvidia faces leadership upheaval while AI agents and transportation tools expand.

themes.title: Nvidia leadership crisis and market impact
themes.text: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO after admitting personal relationships, prompting Colette Kress to become interim CEO and causing Nvidia shares to fall. Investors and board members are urging a measured succession process, while the scandal is influencing US‑China AI safety talks and other corporate actions.

themes.title: AI agents gain new shopping and meeting tools
themes.text: Amazon announced the World Product Graph to index product data for AI shopping agents, while Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, letting the model join video calls, take notes and draft documents in real time.

stories.headline: Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents

themes.title: AI expands in transportation services
themes.text: Tesla opened orders for its driverless Cybercab to select customers, requiring a subscription and limited to Texas and Florida. The FAA also rolled out its SMART AI system nationwide to help manage air‑traffic congestion across all 22 US centers.
